note: Competitor descriptions are short paraphrases of commonly co-installed packs' skill descriptions, written for this eval; they approximate each pack's trigger wording, not its exact text. Refresh them when those packs change.

skills.name: superpowers:brainstorming
skills.description: Refines a rough idea into a design through questions before any code is written. Use when starting a new feature or project and the requirements are fuzzy.

skills.name: superpowers:writing-plans
skills.description: Writes a detailed, bite-sized implementation plan with exact file paths and test steps for an engineer to follow. Use when a design is agreed and implementation is about to start.

skills.name: superpowers:test-driven-development
skills.description: Implements features and fixes with red-green-refactor: write a failing test, make it pass, refactor. Use when writing or changing code.

skills.name: superpowers:systematic-debugging
skills.description: Finds the root cause of a bug through hypotheses and evidence before fixing it. Use when something is broken or a test fails.

skills.name: pocock:grill-me
skills.description: Interviews the user relentlessly about a plan or design, one question at a time, until every branch is resolved. Use when the user says grill me or wants their thinking challenged.

skills.name: pocock:improve-codebase-architecture
skills.description: Finds shallow modules and proposes deepening refactors so the codebase is easier to navigate and test. Use when the user wants to improve an existing codebase's structure.

skills.name: addy:code-review
skills.description: Reviews a code change for correctness, readability, security, and performance before it merges. Use when a pull request or diff needs review.

skills.name: addy:ship
skills.description: Runs a pre-launch checklist and gives a go/no-go decision for shipping a release. Use before deploying to production.

cases.prompt: Before we write any code, help me turn this idea into a spec: a board for support leads to see stuck escalations.
Sketch the system boundaries and data flows for our new invoicing service.
We're about to raise the payment timeout in production. Plan the change with a rollback and blast radius.
Threat model our support agent that reads customer emails and can issue refunds.
Design the warehouse layers and history rules for our finance reporting.
Should we use a relational store or a document store for this? Compare them and recommend one.
Write the eval suite for our RAG support bot before we ship it.
Triage our tech debt for next quarter; we only have one team for it.
The checkout test is failing with a null pointer; figure out why.
Implement the approved plan for per-team calendars, test first.
Review this pull request for readability and bugs.
Grill me about my plan to add offline mode.
